title: Physics-Attested Federated Learning: Securing Collaborative Anomaly Detection in Critical Water Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2609.34804v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables industrial operators to train shared intrusion detection models without disclosing proprietary operational telemetry. However, existing defences operate strictly in update space, leaving aggregators blind to data poisoning; model updates derived from fabricated telemetry remain indistinguishable from honest contributions. We repurpose process invariants, physical relations that always hold in normal operation, such as conservation of mass, from runtime detection heuristics into a verifiable admission requirement for federated updates, mined automatically from clean operational data. We evaluate this admission gate across two physical water testbeds (SWaT, WADI) and a distribution benchmark (BATADAL), testing seven aggregation rules against telemetry fabrication, exposure-only replay poisoning, and an invariant-aware adaptive adversary. Across three testbeds the mined invariants reject none of 25 hones

translated_title: 物理证明的联邦学习：保障关键水利基础设施中协同异常检测的安全性
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使工业运营商能够在不披露专有运营遥测数据的情况下训练共享的入侵检测模型。然而，现有的防御手段严格在更新空间中运行，使得聚合器对数据投毒攻击视而不见；由伪造的遥测数据导出的模型更新与诚实的贡献无法区分。我们将过程不变量——在正常运行中始终成立的物理关系（例如质量守恒）——从运行时检测启发式方法重新定义为联邦更新的可验证准入要求，这些不变量可从干净的操作数据中自动挖掘。我们在两个物理水利测试平台（SWaT、WADI）和一个分布式基准（BATADAL）上评估了该准入门控机制，针对遥测伪造、仅暴露重放投毒以及具备不变量感知能力的自适应对手，测试了七种聚合规则。在三个测试平台中，挖掘出的不变量对25个诚实的……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将从物理过程自动挖掘出的不变量作为联邦更新的可验证准入要求，从而有效防御针对关键水利基础设施协同异常检测的数据投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes repurposing automatically mined physical process invariants as a verifiable admission requirement for federated updates, effectively defending against data poisoning attacks in collaborative anomaly detection for critical water infrastructure.
